content.short: AnChain.AI is a Web3 risk management firm specializing in AI-powered products.
content.description: AnChain.AI delivers SaaS products and services for companies that have blockchain exposure, with the goal of protecting their users and their own operations from bad actors. The portfolio includes on-chain anti-money laundering checks, fraud detection, and security audits of smart contracts. The company has recently launched a product designed to help enterprises build Web3 projects, deploy smart contracts on the blockchain, and manage the interactions they have with those contracts throughout their lifecycle.
